lines.en: label ayanebonus1:
I knock on Ayane’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Ayane 的门，等她来开门。

lines.en: And, after spending at least fifteen minutes thinking about all she said regarding the way we’ve been looking at the world the other night, I’m ready to spend {i}this{/i} one free of worry.
lines.zh: 在花了至少十五分钟回想她那晚说过的、关于我们看待世界的方式的种种之后，我已经准备好，让{i}今晚{/i}无忧无虑地度过。

lines.en: I’m ready to get back to the way things have always been between us.
lines.zh: 我已经准备好，回到我们之间一直以来的样子。

lines.en: Just a man, a girl, and that man’s penis {i}inside{/i} of that girl.
lines.zh: 只是一个男人、一个女孩，以及那个男人插在那个女孩{i}体内{/i}的阴茎。

lines.en: It’s simple, really. But we get caught up in other things and forget that sometimes.
lines.zh: 其实很简单。可我们总是被别的事缠住，然后就忘了这一点。

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 进来！

lines.en: scene black
I don’t want to forget anymore.
lines.zh: 我不想再忘了。

lines.en: I want to confront this world head-on.
lines.zh: 我想正面迎战这个世界。

lines.en: I want to put my penis inside of that girl.
lines.zh: 我想把我的阴茎插进那个女孩体内。

lines.en: And no matter what tragedy queues up to assault us next, I won’t care.
lines.zh: 而且不管下一场悲剧排着队要来袭击我们，我都不会在意。

lines.en: The darker side of life is always just a step or two behind me. But there is a light inside of this room that will scare it away.
lines.zh: 生活阴暗的那一面总是紧跟在我身后一两步。但在这间屋子里，有某种光会把它吓跑。

lines.en: Even if it’s only for a little while.
lines.zh: 哪怕只能维持一小会儿。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk1
The aforementioned light is a faint pink glow leaking out of a thick plastic bulb, nestled atop one of four columns that keep a second roof over Ayane’s head when she goes to sleep at night.
lines.zh: 我说的那道光，是从一颗厚实的塑料灯泡里漏出的淡淡粉光，那灯泡安在四根柱子中的一根顶上——那四根柱子撑起了 Ayane 夜里入睡时头顶的第二层屋顶。

lines.en: The room smells like a combination of fresh laundry and meticulously suppressed sorrow and, I am well aware that the latter is not something that can appeal to the sense in question-
lines.zh: 房间里的气味，是刚洗好的衣物和精心压抑的悲伤的混合；我当然清楚，后者并不是能取悦嗅觉这种感官的东西——

lines.en: But if it could, it would be something like this.
lines.zh: 但如果它能，那大概就是这个样子。

lines.en: If it could, it’d be something that goes well with fresh laundry or a night under a dying pink light.
lines.zh: 如果它能，它一定会跟刚洗好的衣物、或者一盏将熄的粉光下的夜晚相得益彰。

lines.en: It would be soft — like a pure, white pillow or the fabric of a young girl’s pajama pants.
lines.zh: 它会是柔软的——像一个纯白的枕头，或者少女睡裤的布料。

lines.en: Or her skin.
lines.zh: 或者是她的皮肤。

lines.en: Or her long, blonde hair.
lines.zh: 或者她那金色的长发。

lines.en: Or her hands as her fingers curl around yours and subtly remind you of how much bigger than her you are in a manner that is mildly predatory, but partially pure when carefully refined by a novice heartsmith.
lines.zh: 或者是她的手——当她的手指缠上你的手指，微妙地提醒你，你比她大了多少；那方式带着一点捕食者的意味，却又在一位新手铸心匠的精心打磨下，保留了部分的纯粹。

lines.en: It matches the pillow. You think that to yourself.
lines.zh: 它跟那个枕头很配。你对自己这么说。

lines.en: You take a step back because you’re worried about trampling such a delicate, precious flower. But a second glance at its petals reveals that it has already been trampled time and time again. And still, it rises.
lines.zh: 你后退一步，因为担心踩坏那样一朵娇嫩珍贵的花。可再仔细看看它的花瓣，就会发现它已经被踩过一次又一次。而它依然重新立起来。

lines.en: Still, it lives to see the faint pink light of day as imaginary clouds take tiny bites out of a blue sky that reminds you of the color of her eyes. The same eyes you find yourself drowning in as we speak.
lines.zh: 它依然活着，看着那粉色的微光；想象中的云一小口一小口咬着蓝天，那蓝让你想起她眼睛的颜色。而此刻，你正溺在同一双眼睛里。

lines.en: There are no words, just a prolonged duel between irises — silently trying to infect what they focus on, but helplessly bouncing off of one another because this is impossible.
lines.zh: 没有言语，只有一场漫长的虹膜之间的决斗——都在默默地试图感染自己注视的对象，却又无助地彼此弹开，因为这是不可能的。

lines.en: This is love.
lines.zh: 这就是爱。

lines.en: And it’s a love you never thought you’d know.
lines.zh: 而你从没想过自己会知道这样的爱。

lines.en: But a flicker of the light distracts you from that realization.
lines.zh: 可灯光一闪，把你从这个领悟里拉了出来。

lines.en: The imaginary clouds consume the imaginary sky, and you’re left in the same room where you first trampled that flower.
lines.zh: 想象中的云吞掉了想象中的天空，你又回到了当初第一次踩碎那朵花的房间。

lines.en: Long before you knew it would rise again.
lines.zh: 早在你还不知道它会重新立起来的时候。

lines.en: : Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei。

lines.en: Will you trample it once more?
lines.zh: 你还要再踩一次吗？

lines.en: : Yeah?
: I’m glad you’re here.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你来了。

lines.en: Of course you will.
lines.zh: 你当然会。

lines.en: Because you’re pathetic.
lines.zh: 因为你很可悲。

lines.en: You’re worthless.
lines.zh: 你一文不值。

lines.en: And you do not deserve these prolonged glares or pure, white pillows.
lines.zh: 你配不上这久久的注视，也配不上那些纯白的枕头。

lines.en: Or soft skin or blonde hair or a blue sky or {i}anything{/i} because we all know you’re just a cicada.
lines.zh: 也配不上柔软的皮肤、金色的头发、蓝色的天空，{i}什么都{/i}配不上，因为我们都知道，你不过是一只蝉。

lines.en: And you crawled your way out of the earth with the rest of them.
lines.zh: 你和它们一起，从土里爬了出来。

lines.en: The aforementioned light flickers once more.
lines.zh: 那道光又闪了一下。

lines.en: And a reprieve from an unwelcome happiness carves its name on the tree that is your heart.
lines.zh: 而一次从不受欢迎的幸福中获得的喘息，在你那棵名为心脏的树上刻下了自己的名字。

lines.en: : And {i}why{/i} are you glad, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 那你高兴{i}什么{/i}，Ayane？

lines.en: : Because I love you, of course. Why {i}wouldn’t{/i} I be glad that you’re here?
lines.zh: : 当然是因为我爱你。你在这儿，我{i}怎么会{/i}不高兴？

lines.en: : Because I know you well enough at this point to understand when something is wrong even when you refuse to admit it.
lines.zh: : 因为到了现在，我已经足够了解你，就算你死不承认，我也看得出哪里不对劲。

lines.en: : But Sensei, we {i}just{/i} had a discussion about how I’m all better now. And that I wouldn’t let anything bother me anymore so I could spend more time being the crutch you need to walk the streets of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 可是 Sensei，我们{i}刚刚{/i}才讨论过，我已经完全好了。而且我再也不会让任何事困扰我，这样我就能多花点时间，当你走遍 Kumon-mi 街头时需要的那根拐杖。

lines.en: : And yet you’re already backtracking.
lines.zh: : 可你现在已经在往回缩了。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk2
: I have no idea what you’re talking about. But I suppose it’s possible you might be confusing me with my evil twin sister, Efrosinia. That happens sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么。不过我想，你可能是把我和我的邪恶双胞胎妹妹 Efrosinia 搞混了。这种事时有发生。

lines.en: : Then, does this {i}Efrosinia{/i} have anything she’s hiding from me?
lines.zh: : 那么，这位 {i}Efrosinia{/i} 有什么瞒着我的事吗？

lines.en: : She’s hiding all sorts of things. She’s a spy. That’s her job.
lines.zh: : 她藏着好多事呢。她是个间谍。那是她的工作。

lines.en: : You realize I’m not going to hold it against you for not being unmistakably happy 100%% of the time, right?
lines.zh: : 你明白吧，你不可能百分之百地、毫无疑问地快乐，我不会因为这个怪你。

lines.en: : Right. But {i}I{/i} will hold it against me as I literally {i}just{/i} went on a huge rant about how the world is my oyster and you are my pearl. I should wait a little longer before giving myself a sadness allowance.
lines.zh: : 明白。可我会怪{i}我自己{/i}，因为我{i}刚刚{/i}才长篇大论地说过，世界是我的牡蛎，而你是我的珍珠。我应该再等久一点，才给自己发放悲伤额度。

lines.en: : A...sadness allowance?
lines.zh: : 悲……悲伤额度？

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk3
: One emotional breakdown per month. Conducted privately, of course. So as to not disrupt your daily schedule. But the rest of the time, I’ll be the good ole, happy-go-lucky Ayane. The one you love!
lines.zh: : 一个月一次情绪崩溃。当然是私下进行，好不影响你的日常行程。但其余时间，我都会是那个老样子、无忧无虑的 Ayane。你爱的那个！

lines.en: : I love every Ayane.
lines.zh: : 每一个 Ayane 我都爱。

lines.en: : Even Efrosinia?
lines.zh: : Efrosinia 也爱？

lines.en: : Even Efrosinia.
lines.zh: : Efrosinia 也爱。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk4
: That was the wrong answer, Sensei. You just admitted to sleeping with my made-up twin sister. Now we’re going to have to go to made-up divorce court so I can collect my made-up alimony.
lines.zh: : 这个答案错了，Sensei。你刚刚承认跟我编出来的双胞胎妹妹上过床。现在我们得去编出来的离婚法庭，好让我拿到编出来的赡养费。

lines.en: : Talk to me.
lines.zh: : 跟我说说。

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} talking to you.
lines.zh: : 我{i}正{/i}跟你说着话呢。

lines.en: : Talk to me {i}about whatever is bothering you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 跟我说说{i}到底什么在烦你{/i}。

lines.en: : That is a bad idea.
lines.zh: : 那是个坏主意。

lines.en: : But {i}why{/i} is it a bad idea? I can’t help you if I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 可{i}为什么{/i}是坏主意？我不知道的话就没法帮你。

lines.en: : You can’t help me because it’s {i}your{/i} fault in the first place. That’s why I decided to just suck it up and suppress it.
lines.zh: : 你帮不了我，因为说到底这就是{i}你的{/i}错。所以我才决定咬牙忍着、把它压下去。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk5
: But of course you managed to see through it. And here I thought I was doing a good job.
lines.zh: : 可你当然还是看穿了。我本来还以为自己装得挺好。

lines.en: : It’s something {i}I{/i} did? What?
lines.zh: : 是{i}我{/i}做的什么事？什么？

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk6
: It’s nothing. Don’t even worry about it. Even {i}I{/i} forgot about it for a little while.
lines.zh: : 没什么。别操心了。连{i}我{/i}自己都忘了一会儿。

lines.en: : But that’s probably just because a bunch of other, more extravagant things went down right after and I’m still in disbelief that this is even a thing I have to confront in the first place.
lines.zh: : 不过那大概只是因为紧接着又发生了一连串更夸张的事，而且我到现在都不敢相信，这居然是我必须去面对的东西。

lines.en: : Well, on that note, if your method of confronting it is acknowledging it and then ignoring it, I should both commend you and scold you for tackling things the same exact way I would.
lines.zh: : 嗯，说到这个，如果你面对问题的方式是承认它、然后无视它，那我既要夸你又要骂你——因为你处理事情的方式和我一模一样。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk1
: Thanks and understood. I’ll take some time to rethink my approach for future confrontations once I’m done being mad at you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，明白了。等我生完你的气，我会花点时间重新想想以后面对问题的方式。

lines.en: : Is there anything I can do in the meantime to assist with that?
lines.zh: : 在那之前，有什么我能做的吗？

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk2
: You know, as a matter of fact, there is. But revealing that to you is exactly what I’ve been trying to avoid in-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，还真有。可告诉你是恰恰我一直想避免的——

lines.en: : Chika talked to you, didn’t she?
lines.zh: : Chika 找你谈过了，对吧？

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk7
: Oh.
: So you already knew.
lines.zh: : 所以你早就知道了。

lines.en: : I had a feeling that had to be it. I don’t think I’ve made any other big mistakes involving you recently.
lines.zh: : 我有种感觉，一定是这件事。我想我最近也没在你身上犯过别的什么大错。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk8
: Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : This is a sit-down conversation, Sensei. If we’re going to talk about something that makes me extremely {i}un{/i}comfortable, I’d at least prefer to do it in a comfortable spot.
lines.zh: : 这得坐下来谈，Sensei。既然我们要聊让我极度{i}不{/i}舒服的事，我至少希望待在一个舒服的地方谈。

lines.en: : The bed’s right behind you. And I’d be happy to discuss this at length if it helps clear things up.
lines.zh: : 床就在你身后。我也不介意慢慢聊，只要能把事情说清楚。

lines.en: : Yeah...I bet you would.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我猜你当然不介意。

lines.en: scene black
That aforementioned light from moments ago dims as I move beneath it. And while I’m sure that just means my eyes are taking in less of it, I like to think that it’s changing for me.
lines.zh: 刚才那道光在我走到它下面时暗了下来。虽然我敢肯定那只是因为我的眼睛接收到的光变少了，但我更愿意认为是它为我而改变了。

lines.en: That it sees me as undeserving of its warmth or vibrancy. That it’s conserving its color for the one who sees it most.
lines.zh: 它觉得我配不上它的温暖和鲜明。它在为那个最常见到它的人保留自己的颜色。

lines.en: The one who has never done anything wrong, yet continues to be trampled because she bloomed in the wrong garden.
lines.zh: 那个从没做错任何事、却因为开错了花园而一直被踩踏的人。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk9
But I can not pluck this flower as its stem is too tightly rooted to the ground of my inadequacy.
lines.zh: 但我无法摘下这朵花，因为它的茎已经深深扎进了我那片无能的土壤。

lines.en: And I can not look away as it's far too beautiful.
lines.zh: 而我也无法移开视线，因为它实在太美了。

lines.en: All I can do is try to avoid stepping on it in the future — but this entire field is full of flowers.
lines.zh: 我能做的，只有努力在未来别再踩上去——可整片田野都开满了花。

lines.en: And anywhere I go, I’ll be trampling something.
lines.zh: 而无论我走到哪里，都会踩坏点什么。

lines.en: : Are you going to start or should I?
lines.zh: : 你先说，还是我先说？

lines.en: : I’ll start.
lines.zh: : 我先。

lines.en: : Good. That was the right answer.
lines.zh: : 很好。这答案正确。

lines.en: : Guess it’s not just Ami you’re not taking any nonsense from anymore, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来现在不只是 Ami 了，你也不再吃任何人那一套了，是吧？

lines.en: : I’m tired of being stepped on. And if I’m going to get caught up in a never-ending time loop, I need to stop letting that happen or my life is going to be miserable. And that extends to you as well, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我受够了被踩。既然要被困在一个永无止境的时间循环里，我就必须停止让这种事发生，否则我的人生会惨不忍睹。这一点对你同样适用，Sensei。

lines.en: : You’re not exempt from my wrath just because I love you. I still have feelings, you know. I’m not some girl you can just sacrifice to make your life easier and-
lines.zh: : 你不会因为我爱你就能免于我的怒火。我也有感情的好吗。我不是那种你可以随手牺牲掉、好让你自己日子好过一点的女孩，而且——

lines.en: : I said I’d start.
lines.zh: : 我说了，我先说。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk10
: Sorry...go ahead.
lines.zh: : 抱歉……你说。

lines.en: : Well...as you know, I’m {i}involved{/i} with a number of girls.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你也知道，我跟好几个女生{i}有关系{/i}。

lines.en: : That’s putting it lightly.
lines.zh: : 这话说得可真含蓄。

lines.en: : It seemed more gentle to put it that way than outright saying I’m fucking a sizable portion of the class. But if you want me to be more brutally honest, I will.
lines.zh: : 这么说比直截了当地讲我在操班上相当一部分人要委婉。不过如果你想听更残酷的实话，我也可以。

lines.en: : Fine by me. I can take it at this point.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。到这一步我扛得住。

lines.en: : When Chika came to me about this, I was probably just as shocked as you were when {i}you{/i} first found out.
lines.zh: : Chika 来找我提这件事的时候，我大概和{i}你{/i}第一次知道时一样震惊。

lines.en: : You obviously don’t know all the details of our relationship, but Chika is extremely possessive and-
lines.zh: : 你显然不清楚我们关系的全部细节，但 Chika 占有欲极强，而且——

lines.en: : Everybody and their mother knows that. It’s just {i}me{/i} who has the fortune of knowing you’re sleeping with her.
lines.zh: : 这谁不知道啊。只有{i}我{/i}有幸知道你还跟她上床。

lines.en: : You’re not the only one who knows that, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 知道这件事的不止你一个，Ayane。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So I’m just the first one in line for the threesome. Got it.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。所以我在三人群的队伍里排第一个。明白了。

lines.en: : There is no {i}line.{/i} Now, let me finish.
lines.zh: : 没有什么{i}队伍{/i}。好了，让我说完。

lines.en: : When Chika came to me, I was shocked. I didn’t think she’d be the one to propose something like this when she’s more or less looked at every other girl the same way Ami has in regard to me.
lines.zh: : Chika 来找我的时候，我很震惊。她看待其他女生的眼光，跟 Ami 看我的那些女生差不多，我没想到会是她提出这种事。

lines.en: : And, I know how this is going to make me sound, but that’s not really an opportunity I wanted to just give up.
lines.zh: : 而且，我知道这话会让我听起来很糟，但那确实不是一个我想白白放弃的机会。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk11
: Of course not. You think with your penis. I just kind of figured your penis would care a little more about my feelings on account of how well it knows me by now.
lines.zh: : 当然不会。你用阴茎思考。我只是以为，你的阴茎既然已经这么了解我了，多少会在意一点我的感受。

lines.en: : It does. {i}I do.{/i} And I get that you and Chika aren’t really close or anything, but I still wanted it to be you.
lines.zh: : 它在意。{i}我在意{/i}。我知道你和 Chika 其实不怎么亲近，但我还是希望那个人是你。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk12
: Do you have any idea how that makes {i}me{/i} feel? It’s hard enough just knowing that I have to secretly share you with everyone. But having one of them come up to me and rub it in my face?
lines.zh: : 你知道这让我什么感受吗？光是知道{i}我{/i}必须偷偷跟所有人分享你，就已经够难了。可还要让她们其中一个跑来我面前炫耀？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how degraded that made me feel? Do you know what it was like being looked down on like that? And having you held in front of my face like some kind of carrot on a stick?
lines.zh: : 你知道那让我觉得自己有多下贱吗？你知道被那样俯视是什么滋味吗？还有把你像挂在棍子上的胡萝卜一样吊在我面前？

lines.en: : No. I don’t have any idea how any of that feels. Just like I had no idea how it must have felt when you read the list I gave you for the first time.
lines.zh: : 不。我完全不知道那是什么感觉。就像我也不知道，你第一次读到我给你的那份名单时，心里是什么滋味。

lines.en: : Then why-
lines.zh: : 那为什么——

lines.en: : Because it felt wrong hiding even more from you after you showed me just how much you value my honesty.
lines.zh: : 因为在你让我看到你有多看重我的诚实之后，再对你隐瞒更多，我觉得不对。

lines.en: : I wrote you that list because I care about you. And I never thought for a second that it would be something you’d just gloss over and forget about.
lines.zh: : 我写那份名单给你，是因为我在乎你。而我从来没有想过，你会把它当成可以一眼带过、转头就忘的东西。

lines.en: : If there’s an option, I want you to be involved. And this was a way to do that without outright telling the world that I’m in love with you.
lines.zh: : 只要有得选，我都希望你在场。而这是个能让你参与进来、又不必向全世界直说我爱你的办法。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk13
: I...I get that. But that feels like too convenient of an excuse and...and I know there has to be to more to it than that.
lines.zh: : 我……我明白。可这听起来像是个太方便的借口，而且……而且我知道背后一定还有别的原因。

lines.en: : Chika thinks you two are super serious...and that you’re this masterpiece of a man who’s fully committed to her and no one else. But that’s not who you are at all.
lines.zh: : Chika 以为你们两个是认真的……以为你是个杰作般的男人，完全只对她一个人。可你根本不是那样的人。

lines.en: : You don’t care about loyalty. You don’t care about exclusivity. You’re practically {i}allergic{/i} to commitment. And those are all things {i}I{/i} know because I love you and accept you despite all of that.
lines.zh: : 你不在乎忠诚。你不在乎专一。你几乎对承诺{i}过敏{/i}。而这些都是{i}我{/i}因为爱你才了解到的，而且尽管有这些，我依然接受你。

lines.en: : But Chika?...
lines.zh: : 可 Chika 呢？……

lines.en: : It’s like...
lines.zh: : 就好像……

lines.en: : It’s like she has no idea who you even are.
lines.zh: : 就好像她根本不知道你是谁。

lines.en: : Who is she so in love with? What kind of mask are you wearing when you’re with her?
lines.zh: : 她爱上的到底是谁？你跟她在一起的时候，戴的是什么样的面具？

lines.en: : The Chika situation spiraled out of control before I could do anything about it.
lines.zh: : 我还没来得及做什么，Chika 那边的事就已经失控了。

lines.en: : You could have, you know, {i}not{/i} had sex with her. That might have helped.
lines.zh: : 你本来可以，你知道的，{i}不{/i}跟她上床。那样也许会有用。

lines.en: : But I {i}like{/i} having sex with her. And I like having sex with you. And I get that I’m disgusting for suggesting you to her, but {i}you{/i} were the one I wanted.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}喜欢{/i}跟她做爱。我也喜欢跟你做爱。我知道我把你提给她很恶心，但我想在一起的人是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk14
: That...hold on. I feel like you’re kind of just sweet-talking me here. There’s no way that’s all it was.
lines.zh: : 这……等等。我觉得你有点只是在哄我。不可能就只是这样。

lines.en: : You probably just...you probably think I’m the {i}safe{/i} option because I already know about her and-
lines.zh: : 你大概只是……大概觉得我是最{i}安全{/i}的选择，因为我已经知道她的事了，而且——

lines.en: : I already told you. You’re not the only one who knows about her.
lines.zh: : 我说过了。知道她的不止你一个。

lines.en: : Then...you might have thought I’d be the first to agree since I’d do anything for you and-
lines.zh: : 那……你也许是觉得我会第一个同意，因为我愿意为你做任何事，而且——

lines.en: : I just wanted it to be you, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望那个人是你，Ayane。

lines.en: : I can’t say for certain there wasn’t more that went into the decision, but the important part is that I wanted you there for it.
lines.zh: : 我不敢说这个决定里没有别的考量，但重要的是，我希望你在场。

lines.en: : I can be with you in front of someone else in a way that is {i}okay.{/i} Won’t it be nice not having to hide for once?
lines.zh: : 我可以当着别人的面跟你在一起，而且是以一种{i}没有问题{/i}的形式。至少这一次不用躲躲藏藏，不是挺好的吗？

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True:
: You’ve {i}been with me{/i} in front of someone else before and, I’m not sure if you remember this, but it was kind of traumatic for me.
lines.zh: : 你以前也当着别人的面{i}跟我做过{/i}，我不知道你还记不记得，那次对我来说挺有心理阴影的。

lines.en: : This won’t be like that. Chika might be intimidating, but she’s not evil the way Kirin is. She’s just genuinely trying to do something nice for me. And if you don’t want to do it, you don’t have to.
lines.zh: : 这次不会那样。Chika 也许让人有压迫感，但她不像 Kirin 那么恶毒。她只是真心想为我做点好事。而如果你不想，你可以不做。

lines.en: else:
: Not if I have to share you with someone else...I have no idea how I’ll feel about that.
lines.zh: : 可如果对象是别人，我就得跟人分享你……我不知道自己会怎么想。

lines.en: : You don’t have to do it if you don’t want to, Ayane. No one is forcing you.
lines.zh: : 你不想做就不做，Ayane。没人逼你。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk12
: But if it’s not me, it’ll just be someone else! And that’s even worse!
lines.zh: : 可如果不是我，就会是别的什么人！而那样更糟！

lines.en: : I don’t want someone else. I want you. And I get that it might be uncomfortable, but...try to look at it the way {i}she{/i} does — as a celebration of our...passion for one another. Or something.
lines.zh: : 我不想要别人。我想要你。我知道这可能会不舒服，不过……试着像{i}她{/i}那样看待这件事——把它当成对我们之间……激情的一次庆祝。之类的。

lines.en: : Adding “or something” doesn’t make that sound very convincing, Sensei. Nor does the part where Chika would be celebrating her apparent passion for some fake version of you. I lose no matter what here.
lines.zh: : 加个“之类的”并不会让这话更有说服力，Sensei。更何况 Chika 庆祝的，分明是她对某个虚假版本的你的激情。不管怎么选，我都是输的那个。

lines.en: : You’re not losing anything. And this doesn’t have to be some sort of depressing experience. If you already know it’s happening behind the scenes, what’s the harm in just...participating?
lines.zh: : 你没有失去任何东西。而且这也不必是什么压抑的经历。既然你早就知道它在幕后发生，干脆……参与进来又有什么坏处？

lines.en: : The harm is that seeing you fuck some other girl is a lot easier to ignore when it’s just a thing that happens inside of my head. But in person? That’ll hurt me. Do you {i}want{/i} to hurt me?
lines.zh: : 坏处在于，看你操别的女生这件事，如果只是发生在我脑子里，要忽略它容易得多。可亲眼看见呢？那会伤到我。你{i}想{/i}伤我吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. Which is why I’ll do everything in my power to make it enjoyable for you if you decide to go through with this.
lines.zh: : 当然不想。所以如果你决定做，我会倾尽全力让你也享受其中。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk15
: Sensei, I’ve {i}already{/i} decided to go through with it. I told Chika I would and everything.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我{i}已经{/i}决定要做了。我都跟 Chika 说好了。

lines.en: : I’m no stranger when it comes to suffering for someone else's sake. I gave up sex with you for like, an eternity just to make Maya shut up. I just wanted you to know I’m not happy about this.
lines.zh: : 为了别人受苦这种事我可不陌生。我为了堵住 Maya 的嘴，放弃了跟你做爱差不多整整一个永恒。我只是想让你知道，我对此并不高兴。

lines.en: : And I really wish you would have come to me before she did. It’s one thing to hear about wanting a threesome from {i}you,{/i} but having it come from someone else just makes me feel like an afterthought.
lines.zh: : 而且我真希望你能在她之前来找我。想要三人行这种话从{i}你{/i}嘴里说出来是一回事，可从别人嘴里说出来，就让我觉得自己是个事后才被想到的人。

lines.en: : You’re not an afterthought, Ayane. And, if it’ll make you feel any better, I promise to have a threesome with you and anyone else {i}you{/i} want afterward to make up for this.
lines.zh: : 你不是事后才被想到的人，Ayane。而且如果这能让你好受点，我答应你，之后你想跟谁三人行都可以，我{i}来{/i}补偿这次。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk16
: I’m not in the mood for jokes right now, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我现在没心情开玩笑，Sensei。

lines.en: : Sorry. That was in poor taste.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。这话确实不合时宜。

lines.en: : I do want you to know that you weren’t just a {i}sacrifice,{/i} though. I love you and I want you to be there for this.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实想让你知道，你不只是一个{i}牺牲品{/i}。我爱你，我希望你在场。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk17
: Ugh. Why does love have to be so hard?
lines.zh: : 唉。为什么爱非要这么难？

lines.en: : I feel like you could convince me to do literally anything by just telling me you love me over and over. Hearts are annoying. Stop taking advantage of my biggest weakness.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你只要一遍遍跟我说爱我，就能说服我做任何事。心脏真讨厌。别再利用我最大的弱点了。

lines.en: : I’m not taking advantage of-
lines.zh: : 我没有在利用——

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk18
: I know. I’m just being a bit of a jerk to try and get back at you for hurting my feelings again.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我只是故意使点小性子，报复你又伤了我的心。

lines.en: : But if you really want to do this...fine. I’ll try to put up with sharing you for a little while.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你真想做……行吧。我会试着忍一阵子，跟别人分享你。

lines.en: : I had a feeling this would happen eventually, you know. I just kind of figured I’d be more of a deciding factor in it rather than the third wheel.
lines.zh: : 我有预感这事早晚会发生，你知道吧。我只是以为自己在里面会更有决定权，而不是当个电灯泡。

lines.en: : You’ll never be a third wheel at this point, Ayane. You’re too important to me.
lines.zh: : 到了这一步，你永远不会是电灯泡，Ayane。你对我来说太重要了。

lines.en: : There you go again...trampling all over my poor heart with those little reassurances.
lines.zh: : 你又来了……用那些小小的安慰，把我可怜的心踩了一遍又一遍。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk19
: The only question now is whether or not I’ll be any fun as a threesome partner despite not being into girls. She’s probably going to try and touch me, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 现在唯一的问题是，尽管我对女生没兴趣，我这个三人行搭档会不会好玩。她大概会想来碰我吧？

lines.en: : I feel like it would be difficult not to.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她很难忍住不碰。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk20
: You’re gonna owe me for this, by the way.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，这事你欠我的。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m well aware. Anything you want is fine by me.
lines.zh: : 哦，我很清楚。你想要什么都行。

lines.en: : I don’t have anything yet, but I’ll keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 我现在还没想到，不过我会记着的。

lines.en: : Understood.
lines.zh: : 明白。

lines.en: : And thank you, Ayane. For everything.
lines.zh: : 还有谢谢你，Ayane。为我做的一切。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk21
: {i}Hah...{/i}yeah, yeah. I’m pretty great. And only a little bit disappointed in myself for not being able to stay mad.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}是是是。我可真棒。而且我对自己只有一点点失望，因为我居然没办法一直生气下去。

lines.en: : But I guess I {i}was{/i} just mentioning how I wanted to go back to being the careless, happy Ayane I promised to be. So...maybe I can do that now.
lines.zh: : 不过我{i}刚刚才{/i}说过，我想变回那个我承诺要做的、无忧无虑的快乐 Ayane。所以……也许现在就能做到了。

lines.en: : All things considered, this definitely isn’t as grave of a problem as the world literally ending. So maybe it won’t be all that bad after all.
lines.zh: : 总的来看，这总归不像世界真的要毁灭那么严重。所以也许没那么糟。

lines.en: : I’ll take good care of you. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我会好好对你的。别担心。

lines.en: scene ayanebedtalk20
: You always do.
lines.zh: : 你一直都是。

lines.en: : And {i}we’ll{/i} take care of you as well.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我们{/i}也会好好对你。

lines.en: : I’m looking forward to it.
lines.zh: : 我很期待。

lines.en: : I can tell. Your eyes just lit up.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来。你的眼睛刚刚亮了一下。

lines.en: : Yeah, I had a feeling. This can’t come soon enough.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我有感觉。这事真是越快到越好。

lines.en: : There’s a joke to be made there, but I think I’ll let it slide for now.
lines.zh: : 这里本来可以开个玩笑，不过这次我就放过它了。

lines.en: : How about this weekend?
lines.zh: : 这周末怎么样？

lines.en: : Are you sure that’s okay? You don’t need more time to...prepare or anything?
lines.zh: : 你确定没问题吗？你不需要更多时间……准备一下什么的？

lines.en: : I feel like every day we wait, you’ll be dying a little inside. So just relax and let Chika and I work out the specifics or something. I don’t know. I’m new to threesome organization.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们每多等一天，你心里就会死掉一点。所以你放松就好，具体细节交给我和 Chika 去商量什么的。我也不知道。组织三人行我可是新手。

lines.en: : I’m looking forward to this weekend, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我很期待这周末，Ayane。

lines.en: : I bet you are.
lines.zh: : 我猜也是。

lines.en: scene black
: But that doesn’t mean {i}tonight{/i} has to be over just yet.
lines.zh: : 但这不代表{i}今晚{/i}就这么结束了。

lines.en: The flower tramples me for once.
lines.zh: 这一次，换那朵花来踩我了。

lines.en: But that’s okay — for we nurture one another soon after.
lines.zh: 不过没关系——因为很快，我们就互相滋养了彼此。

lines.en: And the night {i}does{/i} come to an end.
lines.zh: 而夜晚{i}终究{/i}是结束了。

lines.en: Just other things happen first.
lines.zh: 只是中间先发生了别的事。

lines.en: Things I decide to keep to myself this time.
lines.zh: 这一次，我决定把那些事藏在心里。

lines.en: She deserves at least that.
lines.zh: 她至少值得这一点。

lines.en: We deserve at least this.
lines.zh: 我们至少值得这个。
